system.description: You can use your cybernetics to support and enhance your physical actions. When you roll on a task to carry, climb, jump, or smash and your roll is less than a 9, treat the roll as a 9. (This means you don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) This ability renews when you take a recovery. Enabler; action to carry, climb, jump, or smash. Effort: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3. At tier 3: The minimum number rolled for this ability increases to 12.
